reviews.text: Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
The tech and the doctor were all very gentle with my pet

Ruined the experience of taking our newly adopted baby to his first vet visit with us. I was not informed why a different vaccine was given, it was supposed to be his last dose, but I guess since a different vaccine was given, he needed another dose so we were asked to schedule for another visit. He was also supposed  to be given his second dose of Nexgard and Ponazuril but was not given at our visit and nothing was explained about that. The vet and the one at the desk was very pleasant but the staff who brought in the payment package plans looked at us like "I don't think you can afford this". She was not pleasant at all.

The experience was very business like, I was expecting to feel that our fur baby is in good hands. Having said that, we are not coming back, hopefully the second vet clinic we plan to go to is more warm and sincere.
The doctors on staff here are very thorough and understanding.
Great customer service and easy to make an appointment

I really appreciated that Dr. Scott was so patient and gentle with my elderly dog. He gave her nice yoga stretches trying to diagnose her pain issues. It was so fun to watch. He was really informative and didn’t try to cheat us by recommending tests that he felt our dog didn’t need. He seemed like he really cared and I appreciated that.

I took my dog for a simple nail trim, but one nail was cut too short and bled. Accidents happen, but I was deeply disappointed by the response. Instead of a sincere apology or showing empathy for my dog's pain and stress, the staff was dismissive, simply saying "it could happen." My dog was highly distressed and wheezing afterward. Due to the lack of care and empathy, I don't think I will be returning.

First puppy visit and our anxiety was high alert. Vet. Andy Scott and the nurses/assistants greeted us and so patient and considerate to our questions and concerns. We found our puppy medical and dental care. Thank you so much from Luna and our family.
Thank you for your rating. We appreciate your feedback and are always looking for ways to improve.
I was not happy with the veterinarian this time. I felt she chastised me because my dog was very nervous. She also offered many services that I declined.
The technician was professional , he did good job for service my dog, pretty professional with large size dogs,

I can in for a booster shot for vaccinations I got two weeks prior from Vetco. I asked if I had to pay the vet exam fee and was told that I had to pay for a tech fee of $57. When I came in for the original shots I didn’t have to pay any additional fees, why the difference? If a person is coming in for follow up or boosters they should not have to pay for additional fees. When my dog was taken from me to get the shots (I normally hold him, he weights 100lbs) I heard your tech swear and should like she was getting frustrated with my dog, this is why I asked to hold him for them.
The visit was not what I would have expected and not what I have gotten before.

This place is not cat friendly at all. This is the personal hell for cats and their owners. No sort of separation from the cats and dogs, so the dogs act like psychopaths, screaming at the other dogs and it’s horrifying for the cats. They used to do it where you would get a full vet visit at least. We went there for flea protection pills, and they tell us they only do vaccines and stuff and recommended us a topical rub that’s like $100-$200 more than retail price. Also this place used to not take you if you’re 15 minutes late, even if you call them beforehand to let them know. I actually despise this spot. I only came back because Cheshire Cat Clinic is closed on Sundays and it was urgent. This place has always been centered around dogs, and it’s clear even by the attitude of the vets.

Doctor Hsu was curt, didn't explain options well and down talked to the owner. I voiced concerns of over-booking and she told me to look elsewhere. She used non common terms like cytology and shows disdain when a non medical customer didn't understand what it was. Ended up leaving the vet for a 2nd opinion and lost out on a day. Avoid this doctor!

Had a great experience. This was our first visit to Vetco and Lizbeth was very helpful and accommodating. She is bilingual and able to explain everything to my mother whose main language is Spanish. The veterinarian Dr. Foster was also very helpful and was knowledgeable about my dogs condition and showed him a lot of patience and care.

I have been taking my cats here for their annual and dental cleanings. I am extremely happy with their visits. The vet, Dr. Scott, was thorough as he explained medical conditions. I also had exceptional customer service from Patrick, JonRoy (?), and LizBeth. Patrick even helped out when my male cat was a hard blood draw (just like his momma!) 👋

Horrible, cold hearted doctor! Prices way too high for this type of clinic setting!
Unable to even do simply things with care like a vaccine and nail trim!
the vet was horrible
Always a great experience at Vetco in Mira Mesa, from the beginning to check out. They are always on time and are very up front and honest about everything. I know my baby is in good hands.
They gave our dog excellent  care
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

I brought my dog in for treatment, which included being told I can bring him back for another allergy injection.
Today I was told the vet was merely a "relief" Dr. And I need to pay for another exam.
This type of bait and switch is horrible. Either bring on qualified veterinarians or don't. But dont tell me "policy  changed".

Since I need a new exam, I will find a client focused service.

Update 11/13/2025
I emailed the address Vetco provided, yet I have not received any communication in return. I have no interest in receiving feigned compassion; their comment was merely a public display of attentiveness and not a serious attempt to resolve the issue.
Everyone was helpful and listen to my concerns, about my dog Louie. The doctor was helpful in explaining everything I needed to do too!

The doctors and staff at the hospital are excellent—very professional, caring, and attentive. However, the phone customer service is quite disappointing. It seems to be handled by an off-site call center, and they are often unable to access records or approve medications ordered online. This creates unnecessary delays and frustration.
Took my baby in for follow-up after ER visit over weekend Dr Hsu & staff were very thorough & efficient
I finally found a great vet with affordable cost!  This team of vets and assistants are awesome!  I am so very happy!
amazing staff and care

Staff was so sweet and attentive! My pup was suffering the annual bout of flea and allergy season and I needed a quick last-minute appointment for him to be seen. This site had lots of availability which can be difficult especially for a Friday afternoon. Check-in was super quick. Our vet for the appointment was super kind and thoughtful but also professional and direct. I highly recommend this Vetco location!
We're thrilled to see that you gave us a high rating! Your support means a lot to us, and we're glad we could provide you with a positive experience.
Great service. From the Checking in process thru the checkout.

Everyone at the appt was very nice, from reception, to the tech, to the vet. They didn't overcharge and even looked at my dog's behind at no extra cost (her glands were starting to get a little full, I had noticed her scooting).

However! A few weeks later she has started her seasonal/summer itching, and it is impossible to call the actual office and ask about a vet tech appointment for a cytopoint shot. The call center* said she needs an exam first, which she had less than 2.5 weeks ago, which included parasite screening. I brought them a stack of vet records, including some with cytopoint on them, from 9 years!

I find it ridiculous to pay for another exam 2 weeks later to get an allergy shot. Full disclosure, I took them up on their 1st exam free offer and this feels like a way to get that money back. I truly, truly respect vets but it seems absurd to examine a dog about 2 weeks later. Do they think she got infested already with mites or mange? I regret taking her early for her vaccines, before her summer itching started so they could "examine" her then for the allergy shot.

I hate that I have to give 3 stars, I wanted to give 5, but you can't reach anyone here!

I would like to give a huge shout out to the staff at Petco in Mira Mesa, San Diego. Dr. Scot is patient intelligent, friendly and explains things very well. Linda has a heart of gold and is also very friendly. I’m sorry I can’t remember the names of the other staff. I know there is a man that works there and I know he’s partially Filipino. All staff I have encountered there, including two other vets and all assistance have been personable, friendly knowledgeable, and very caring. I started going there with my former dog. I had to have her put down and Dr. Scott is the one that did it. Now I have another dog and I’ve been taking her there and she just got fixed and had a couple teeth pulled, and they have followed up with text messages to me which I think is wonderful. By the way after my dog, my first dog was put down I got a handwritten card with a message from each of the staff, I was blown away. Anyway, I can’t say enough good things about this stuff in Mira Mesa I will not go anywhere else.
Great place to bring your pets in for vet care!

Thank you Dr. Foster for being so accommodating (to us) and nice (to Tortellini and Bonita) - they weren’t stressed at all. Thank you also to the vet tech (sorry we didnt get your name - long hair with glasses) for handling our cats with care and putting us at ease.

Staff is really nice and hardworking, even the receptionist/ intake nurse. My cat had vomited all over herself in the car ride over and when I told them they immediately brought her back to the room to get her weight and get her cleaned up and her carrier too. My cat is usually extremely stressed out at the vet and tries to run and hide but this time they petted her and scratched behind the ears nonstop until she was comfortable and she was able to feel safe enough to stay up on the table on her own. They helped me lower the bill too when I told them I was struggling at the moment, and let me know if any of the charges/ medications were not vital or could be found elsewhere for cheaper. This was a huge relief to me because I was under a lot of stress the whole time from the situation my cat was in as well as everything else thats putting me in a pressure cooker right now, especially financially. Overall it was a great experience under the circumstances and it was my first time there.

We came in for our annual booster shots and while there got our cat's nails trimmed as well. The staff at our local Vetco are very friendly, knowledgeable, and courteous. Our cat came out not stressed at all.

Inconsiderate, pricey, and most miserable vet I’ve ever switched to.

Also… Don’t buy the fish from Petco. They are rotted with disease and die quickly.

Service was so quick, efficient, and thoughtful. They had a super easy scheduling process online. I think i was in and out of there in 30-40 min, only took longer because my new kitten had some issues. I will be back again soon!

Mira Mesa handled me and my dog (a difficult client) graciously. I am looking after my older parents' dog, who was never properly socialized, so I can't exactly fix her behavior overnight, nor can I neglect her vet appointments. So I'm in a bit of a bind, having to take a reactive dog to a very public place. Nevertheless, the employees tried to do what they could to separate us from other dogs.

I was recommended teeth cleaning. Had no problem booking a consult and a follow up appointment, and I was always shown the estimate before I signed anything.

It would be nice if my pet's vax information was always up to date, but! hot tip for the people leaving reviews: the individual practices aren't responsible for that.. So be nice lol. As long as they have you on file AT the location, it gets easier. I think the vet department here is doing very well.
I was very comforted by the kind and gentle service provided by Dr Hsu and Linda.  They were so accommodating and answered all of my questions and concerns.  Thank you!

The vet (a guy, I can't remember his name) gave me a run for my money and scared the heck out of me. He told me my male kitten had a testical that wasn't dropped and told me if I didn't get it surgically removed that it could cause cancer. Then he checked him again and felt the second one. He put my baby in distress twice which was completely unnecessary. My baby was uncomfortable as is. Will never be going to a Petco Vet Hospital again. It's extremely over priced as well.
Dr. Hsu and Linda were very helpful and attentive while taking care of my cat.
We love Vetco Mira Mesa. Everyone who works there goes above and beyond to give the best care to my pets.
Hi. Mj. We appreciate your excellent review! Thank you, and we hope to see you again soon!
Dr. Scott of Petco Mira Mesa and his assistant Erika was amazing. They're very helpful and accommodating to our dog Whiskey. Thank you.
Your 5-star rating means a lot to us - thank you for taking the time to share your positive experience!

5-star review would be to Dr. Peggy Hsu for her dedication and professionalism. Her report on my dog, Roxy, after her examination is thorough, excellent explanation. Her treatment for flea, tick, and heartworm for Roxy has proven …
We appreciate your support and look forward to serving you again. Thank you!
